entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:5
segments: The tempter. When Jesus was being tempted of the devil in the wilderness the tempter's first suggestion to him was to return to the ease of worldly life by using his divine power to relieve the hunger of his body (
).  Paul feared lest the Thessalonians would be led back into the easier life of the world through weariness of persecutions.
